description: Tre grafikkforslag til handlinger i planlagt varemeny; ikke implementert i spillet.

icons.label: Legg under disken
icons.description: En vare under bordplata og en pil ned.
icons.subject: A small plain wooden counter occupies left two-thirds: horizontal tabletop at mid-height, two short legs extending down. Red parcel is BELOW the tabletop BETWEEN the legs, visible in the storage space. A large gold arrow on the right points straight DOWN, indicating moving the item beneath the counter. Keep tabletop bare. Tabletop at y60 in 128px coordinates, parcel centered around x47 y89. Arrow x96 pointing down from y29 to y100.
icons.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one square 128px game action icon for Julemarked's item menu. References: first image is STYLE ONLY (existing app-minbod icon), second is STYLE ONLY (app-nettbutikk). Create a new pictogram, not either existing app symbol. Match these icons' warm cream rounded-square tile, thin stepped dark brown #1d1a16 border, transparent outside corners, small crisp fine pixel clusters and simple 3-4 tone material shading, warm upper-left light. Same square canvas and inset rounded cream tile for all action icons, object contents inset ~16px. Readable at 32px and 48px. No text, numbers, letters, hands, people, scenic background, smooth vector/3D rendering, blur, dithering noise, extra symbols or decorations. Main axes horizontal/vertical. Only one cream tile and one action pictogram. Use a small deep red cubical parcel with cream vertical band as the generic ITEM, warm brown wood for counter, kraft brown for carton, clear warm GOLD chunky vertical arrow on the RIGHT. Arrow must be unmistakable and not collide with parcel/counter. Primary request: A small plain wooden counter occupies left two-thirds: horizontal tabletop at mid-height, two short legs extending down. Red parcel is BELOW the tabletop BETWEEN the legs, visible in the storage space. A large gold arrow on the right points straight DOWN, indicating moving the item beneath the counter. Keep tabletop bare. Tabletop at y60 in 128px coordinates, parcel centered around x47 y89. Arrow x96 pointing down from y29 to y100.

icons.subject: A small plain wooden counter occupies left two-thirds: horizontal tabletop at mid-height, two short legs extending down. Empty storage area below table. Tabletop at y60 in 128px coordinates, parcel centered around x47 y43. Arrow x96 pointing UP from y100 to y29.
